{{Top|leg}}
A '''hyperspace shunt''' was a key component of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] unit. The shunt would transfer excess heat and power away from the hyperdrive, preventing damage to the internal systems.<ref name="Dark Apprentice">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>
